notes.title: Paradise's Secrets Big Update
notes.content:
Hello dear players!
Thank you for your continued interest in our game. With great excitement, we present to you our first major update, which we’ve been working on meticulously since its release. With this update, we aim to offer you an even more thrilling experience by enhancing the game’s story, horror atmosphere, and suspenseful elements. Here are the new additions in the update:

[b]New Cinematics[/b]

New cinematics have been added to the House, Paradise Company, Mansion, and Hospital maps:
[list]
[*] Paradise Company: A new cinematic showing a dialogue between a patient who previously asked for help from Paradise and an employee has been added.
[*] Paradise Company: New cinematics depicting the treatment process involving Kevin's parents, Susan and James, on a patient have been added.
[*] Mansion: New cinematics related to Percival Hicks’s past have been added, supporting the storyline about Percival and the child he kidnapped.
[*] Mansion: A new cinematic and voiceover reflecting the child’s thoughts during their imprisonment have been added.
[*] Hospital: New scenes contributing to the mother character’s storyline have been added.
[*] Hospital: A cinematic of a heated argument between David Starlight and Ricci has been added.
[/list]

[b]New Voiceovers[/b]

New voiceovers have been added to enhance the game's story and tension:

[list]
[*] House: Voiceovers of Kevin's past, including conversations between his parents, have been added.
[*] Paradise Company: The tone of the announcements heard since our second visit has been altered to create a darker atmosphere.
[*] Mansion: A voiceover of the poem written by the child character to Tweetie has been added. (Accessible in the room on the left when climbing the stairs in the Mansion.)
[*] Mansion: New voiceovers reflecting the child character’s experiences have been added.
[*] Mansion: New voiceovers for Percival’s phone conversation with Mrs. Gray have been added.
[*] Mansion: New voiceovers for Percival expressing his feelings have been added.
[*] Hospital: New voiceovers expressing the mother character's thoughts and emotions have been added.
[/list]

[b]New Languages[/b]

[list]
[*] The game now supports Japanese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese.
[/list]

[b]Performance Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] We have worked on improving the optimization of the game. Players experiencing FPS issues are advised to adjust the Global Illumination Quality setting to medium or low.
[/list]

[b]New Jumpscares and Horror Elements[/b]

[list]
[*] Hospital: New jumpscares and voiceovers have been added to intensify the horror atmosphere.
[*] Hospital: The mother character has been reused in several locations to enhance the horror atmosphere.
[*] Hospital: In the room where we retrieve the heart organ, heartbeat sound effects have been added to maintain the tense atmosphere.
[/list]
[b]New Interactive Items[/b]

[list]
[*] House: New interactive items, such as lasagna, a baseball bat, a basketball, and a photo hanging in a fridge, have been added to the game.
[/list]

In conclusion, with this update, we aimed to make your game experience more immersive, enriched, and exciting. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, so please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts.
We wish you a great gaming experience!
